q.en: What did humans start doing in the Neolithic Age?

exp.en: In the Neolithic Age, humans transitioned from hunting-gathering to agriculture, settling in permanent villages and domesticating plants and animals.

exp.en: Neolithic communities cultivated crops and domesticated animals, often living in villages. Hunting, gathering and fishing could continue alongside farming.
exp.hi: नवपाषाण समुदाय फसलें उगाते, पशु पालते और प्रायः गाँवों में रहते थे। कृषि के साथ शिकार, संग्रहण और मछली पकड़ना भी जारी रह सकता था।
